# Preventive Home Solutions

> Licensed and insured plumbing, heating and air conditioning company headquartered in Layton, Utah, serving homeowners in 10 Northern Utah cities across Davis, Weber and Box Elder counties.

- Address: 688 N Main St, Layton, UT 84041
- Phone: (385) 453-9428

- Website: https://www.preventivehomesolutions.com
- Service area: Layton, Ogden, Clinton, Syracuse, West Point, Roy, Clearfield, Riverdale, Brigham City and Kaysville, Utah

## Services

- [Plumbing](https://www.preventivehomesolutions.com/plumbing): drain cleaning, leak detection and repair, sewer services, water line replacement, sump pumps, toilets, faucets, garbage disposals, emergency plumbing
- [Water heaters](https://www.preventivehomesolutions.com/water-heater-repair): tank and tankless repair, replacement and installation
- [Heating / HVAC](https://www.preventivehomesolutions.com/hvac): furnace repair and installation, boilers, heat pumps, ductless mini-splits, thermostats, indoor air quality, emergency heating
- [Air conditioning](https://www.preventivehomesolutions.com/ac): AC repair, installation, tune-ups, refrigerant service, emergency cooling
- [Coupons](https://www.preventivehomesolutions.com/coupons)
